title: PMDG 777‑200LR FINALLY Hits MSFS 2024 Marketplace! ✈️ New Aircraft & Liveries This Week (PC)
description:
MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: PMDG 777-200LR, Boeing 727 & New Aircraft!

On April 11, 2026, the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for PC brings massive additions, headlined by the long-awaited PMDG 777-200LR! This week’s MSFS 2024 update features legendary trijets, bush planes, and essential performance expansions for your virtual hangar.
✈️ New aircrafts added this week (PC)

The following aircrafts were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 FlightSim Studio AG: Boeing 727‑200F (Classic cargo trijet for vintage jet fans)
🛫 FlightSim Studio AG: Boeing 727‑200RE Super27 Expansion (Performance upgrade for the 727)
🛫 SimWorks Studios: Kodiak 100 (Versatile turboprop for bush flying)
🛫 PMDG Simulations: PMDG 777‑200LR (Ultra long‑range widebody airliner)

🎨 New Liveries added this week (PC)
The following liveries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🎨 AERODYNAMICS: C172/152 LIVERIES (Extra paint options for your GA fleet)

If you enjoyed this weekly Marketplace Update, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for more MSFS content, and let me know in the comments which aircraft you’re adding to your hangar this week!
Thanks for watching and happy flying
✈️ See you in the skies!
